results.name: 180 Jump Turns
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and lower into a shallow squat with your chest up.
Drive through your feet to jump vertically while rotating your body 180 degrees in the air.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent, facing the opposite direction.
Repeat the movement, alternating the direction of rotation.
tips: Keep your knees aligned with your toes during takeoff and landing.
Exhale during the jump and inhale as you land and reset.
Maintain a controlled rhythm and prioritize landing quality over speed.
Land softly on the balls of your feet by bending your knees.
results.description: 180 Jump Turns is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core, Obliques.

results.name: Agility Ladder Advanced Hop Position
instructions: Stand at the end of an agility ladder on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward into the first square, landing softly on both feet.
Keep hopping through each square in a quick, steady rhythm.
Pump your arms and stay light on your feet to the end of the ladder.
tips: Stay on the balls of your feet; avoid landing on your heels.
Speed comes after clean footwork.
results.description: Agility Ladder Advanced Hop Position is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Agility Ladder Advanced Single-Leg
instructions: Stand on one leg at the end of an agility ladder.
Hop forward into each square on the same leg, landing softly.
Keep your balance and a quick rhythm through the ladder.
Repeat the drill on the other leg.
tips: Land with a slightly bent knee that tracks over your toes.
Use your arms for balance.
results.description: Agility Ladder Advanced Single-Leg is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Agility Ladder Advancing Laterally Switching Base
instructions: Stand side-on at the end of the agility ladder in an athletic stance.
Move sideways along the ladder, stepping in and out of each square while switching your lead foot.
Keep your hips low and your feet quick.
Continue to the end of the ladder, then repeat leading with the other side.
tips: Stay low and keep your chest up.
Keep the rhythm before trying to go faster.
results.description: Agility Ladder Advancing Laterally Switching Base is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Adductors, Abductors.

results.name: Agility Ladder Lateral Movement With Double Hop
instructions: Stand side-on at the end of the agility ladder on the balls of your feet.
Hop sideways into the first square, then hop again in the same square.
Continue moving sideways with two quick hops in each square.
Repeat the drill moving in the other direction.
tips: Keep your hops small and quick.
Land softly with your knees bent.
results.description: Agility Ladder Lateral Movement With Double Hop is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Abductors.

results.name: Agility Ladder Lateral Movement in in Out
instructions: Stand side-on to the agility ladder, facing along it.
Step into the first square with one foot, then the other.
Step back out with the first foot as you move sideways to the next square.
Repeat the in-in-out pattern quickly along the ladder, then go back the other way.
tips: Count the rhythm out loud at first.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
results.description: Agility Ladder Lateral Movement in in Out is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Adductors, Abductors.

results.name: Agility Ladder Skipping 1 Touch
instructions: Stand at the end of the agility ladder.
Skip forward, touching one foot down in each square.
Drive your opposite knee up and swing your arms with each skip.
Continue in a steady rhythm to the end of the ladder.
tips: Stay light and springy.
Keep your posture tall.
results.description: Agility Ladder Skipping 1 Touch is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes.

results.name: Agility Ladder Skipping 2 Touches
instructions: Stand at the end of the agility ladder.
Skip forward so both feet touch down in each square.
Drive your knees up and swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue quickly to the end of the ladder.
tips: Quick feet with small ground contacts.
Keep your eyes forward, not on your feet.
results.description: Agility Ladder Skipping 2 Touches is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes.

results.name: Agility Ladder in in Out Out Moving Laterally
instructions: Stand side-on to the agility ladder.
Step into a square with one foot, then the other.
Step back out with one foot, then the other, while moving sideways to the next square.
Repeat the pattern along the ladder, then go back the other way.
tips: Keep your hips low and facing forward.
Precision first, then speed.
results.description: Agility Ladder in in Out Out Moving Laterally is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Adductors, Abductors.

results.name: Agility Ladder in in Out Out With Knee Lift
instructions: Stand facing the agility ladder.
Step into the square with one foot, then the other, lifting each knee high.
Step out to the sides of the next square with high knees.
Continue the in, in, out, out pattern to the end of the ladder.
tips: Drive your knees to hip height.
Stay tall; don't lean back.
results.description: Agility Ladder in in Out Out With Knee Lift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes, Core.
